MicroStrategy plans to raise $42bn to buy BTC. Canary Capital applies for SOL ETF. SOL DEX volume hits 168% of ETH. Sol Strategies now owns $24m SOL. Kraken cuts 15% of staff. Tokenization could be big trend: US Treasury. Binance unveils wealth management platform. Centralised stablecoins a risk: Curve founder. FTX engineering director set to remain free. Microsoft shareholders begin BTC vote. Nillion raises $50m to create first ‘blind computer’.

entry.summary: BTC gets to within $175 of ATH. BTC ETF inflow the highest since August. BTC can reach $200k without dollar collapse: Bitwise. Visa allows instant Coinbase deposits. Florida CFO urges state crypto investments. Treasury fails to mention crypto in financial strategy. US at risk of losing crypto leadership: Paxos. Circle raises fees for USDC deposits. dYdX cuts 35% of staff. Kraken offered 25m OP tokens to build L2. DWF partner fired after drink spiking allegations. OKX & TON launch $10m growth fund. STX Nakamoto upgrade goes live.

entry.title: BTC nears ATH, DOGE leads Memecoins, GRASS airdrop hits $1.1B
entry.summary: BTC nears ATH as ETF inflow streak continues. $180m of shorts liquidated in rally. Funds see $24bn of inflows so far in 2024. DOGE up 15% as Elon D.O.G.E. role gains traction. Bhutan moves $66m BTC to Binance. World Liberty Financial to issue stablecoin. Shift4 introduces crypto payments. Show some respect to ETH Foundation: Vitalik. GRASS hits $1.1bn FDV on launch, bandwidth DePin. Phantom goes down amid GRASS airdrop. Chainlink data now available on SOL. Infinex closes $68m patron funding round. Gemini gets exchange approve in Singapore.
